据 HTX 行情，BTC 突破 78,000 美元，现报 78,001.20 美元，24 小时涨幅 0.96%。实时报价 77,990.37，涨幅收窄至 +0.91%。这是一个"突破"，但幅度上更接近区间内的技术性上移，而非趋势性放量拉升。

把镜头拉远，结构更清晰：
• 30 日涨跌：-8.0%
• 7 日涨跌：-2.7%
• 30 日区间：77,368.77 – 86,530.00

也就是说，现价 77,990 处于近 30 日区间的下沿附近，本次"突破 78,000"更像是从区间底部向上的一次修复，距离区间中轴仍有距离。单日 0.96% 的涨幅，不足以定义方向。

再看市场内部：
• $ETH 2,269.41（+1.14%），涨幅略强于 $BTC
• $BNB 705.59（+0.34%），跟随偏弱
• 恐贪指数 34，处于 Fear 区间

这里有一个值得注意的背离：价格站上整数关口，但情绪指标仍在恐惧区。历史上，情绪与价格的背离往往意味着两种可能——要么是底部区域的筑底特征，要么是反弹缺乏共识、后续动能不足。仅凭单日数据无法定论，需要观察成交量与后续能否守住 78,000 一线。

结论：这是一次"数据上成立、结构上待确认"的突破。整数关口的心理意义大于技术意义，真正需要跟踪的是 30 日区间下沿 77,368 是否被有效守住，以及恐贪指数能否持续回升脱离恐惧区。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation?

Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds tied up when you open a position. For example, 10x leverage means 10% of the position value.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing a “Insufficient margin” alert,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin threshold: Once losses eat into the required maintenance margin, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of it first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

translatedData.title: What's the difference between isolated and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you'll be asked to choose between “isolated margin” and “cross margin.” Many beginners just pick one at random and end up taking a big loss.

【Cross Margin】Your entire account balance is used as margin. Advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you're less likely to get liquidated;
Disadvantage: in extreme market conditions, losses could wipe out your entire account. It's like putting all your eggs in one
They all support one another in the same basket.

【Isolated Margin】Only a specific amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the losses won't spread to your other positions or your principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

【My advice】Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you don't yet have the ability to assess the worst-case scenario for a bad trade

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100 U control 1,000 U, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are just getting started ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you make 10 times as much? Today, I’ll explain it in plain English.

【The basics】Leverage means the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100 U in capital and use 10x leverage, you actually control
a position worth 1,000 U. If the coin price rises by 1%, you make 10% on your principal; conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss on your principal—note, the loss is calculated based on the total position you control.

【The cost】With 10x leverage, if the coin price moves against you by about 10%, your principal is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It’s not
that you have to lose 10% before it’s all gone; a drop of about 10% wipes it all out (the exact threshold also depends on the margin rate).
